sentinel.note: 1-1: A narrow patrol platform with wide solar wings and a command tower, a reactor glowing on each wing.
sentinel.name: SENTINEL

thresher.note: 1-2: A heavy hauler with cutting blades at its prow and turrets on its deck.
thresher.name: THRESHER

prowler.note: 1-3: A swept-wing raider with a red reactor and a flak gun on each wing.
prowler.name: PROWLER

pulsar.note: 1-4: A ring-shaped ship around a bright cyan reactor, gatlings on the ring.
pulsar.name: PULSAR

rockbreaker.note: 1-5: A boxy mining ship with prow drills, powered by exposed reactors that shield its core.
rockbreaker.name: ROCKBREAKER

warden.note: 1-6: A wide battle station with side wings and a command tower, bristling with reactors, flak guns and beam emitters.
warden.name: WARDEN

patrol_drone.note: 2-1: A cross-shaped patrol gunship with a tall tower and a gatling on each arm.
patrol_drone.name: PATROL DRONE

cyclone.note: 2-2: A ring ship spinning its turrets around a sandy glowing core.
cyclone.name: CYCLONE

siege_pod.note: 2-3: A rounded armored siege ship around a big orange reactor, smaller reactors on its hull.
siege_pod.name: SIEGE POD

delta_raider.note: 2-4: A delta-winged raider with a teal reactor, twin cannons and flak guns on its wings.
delta_raider.name: DELTA RAIDER

breacher.note: 2-5: A wedge-shaped assault ship with a prow ram, gatlings and missile racks.
breacher.name: BREACHER

harvester.note: 2-6: A heavy prow-shaped harvester with four engines and a green reactor, its deck lined with cannons and turrets.
harvester.name: HARVESTER

turbine.note: 3-1: A ring-shaped ship around a glowing yellow turbine, missile racks and reactors on its rim.
turbine.name: TURBINE

clamp_barge.note: 3-2: A wide salvage barge with a command tower and coral markings, armed with cannons, flak and missile racks.
clamp_barge.name: CLAMP BARGE

spire.note: 3-3: A long command ship carrying a tall tower from stern to prow, cannons all along it.
spire.name: SPIRE

twin_fang.note: 3-4: A wedge-shaped gunship with two fang-like prongs and rows of flak guns.
twin_fang.name: TWIN FANG

frigate.note: 3-5: A long frigate with a command tower and a prow gun, turrets and flak along its deck.
frigate.name: FRIGATE

tidebreaker.note: 3-6: A heavy cruiser with a breakwater prow, cannons and flak batteries.
tidebreaker.name: TIDEBREAKER

picket.note: 4-1: A slim picket ship with gun pods of twin cannons.
picket.name: PICKET

bulwark.note: 4-2: An armored ship with ramming plates in front and missile racks behind them.
bulwark.name: BULWARK

borer.note: 4-3: A boring ship with a drill nose, beam emitters cutting the way ahead.
borer.name: BORER

silo_hauler.note: 4-4: A hauler carrying fuel silos, gatlings and a radar on its deck.
silo_hauler.name: SILO HAULER

bastion.note: 4-5: A fortress ship with thick walls and flak towers.
bastion.name: BASTION

reaper.note: 4-6: A giant harvester with augers in front, flak guns and banks of missile racks.
reaper.name: REAPER

enforcer.note: 5-1: An enforcer gunship behind armor shields, a radar directing its flak.
enforcer.name: ENFORCER

hive_carrier.note: 5-2: A carrier with two hangars, its swarms guided by radar dishes.
hive_carrier.name: HIVE CARRIER

hover_tank.note: 5-3: A heavy hover gunboat with gatling turrets around a reactor.
hover_tank.name: HOVER TANK

cryo_fortress.note: 5-4: A fortress ship with frosted cryo reactors and gatlings.
cryo_fortress.name: CRYO FORTRESS

sentry_grid.note: 5-5: A sentry ship laid out as a grid of missile-rack nodes.
sentry_grid.name: SENTRY GRID

leviathan.note: 5-6: A long battleship lined with turrets from bow to stern.
leviathan.name: LEVIATHAN

relay_array.note: 6-1: A relay station of dish arrays, with beam emitters and a gatling.
relay_array.name: RELAY ARRAY

scavenger.note: 6-2: A patched-up salvager with wing batteries of beam emitters.
scavenger.name: SCAVENGER

mine_carrier.note: 6-3: A mine carrier with launch bays, radars, a turret and a beam emitter.
mine_carrier.name: MINE CARRIER

foundry.note: 6-4: A foundry ship with heavy presses, cannons and a beam emitter.
foundry.name: FOUNDRY

gunship_prime.note: 6-5: A heavy gunship with two big engines and beam emitters along its hull.
gunship_prime.name: GUNSHIP PRIME

colossus.note: 6-6: A giant battle station with flak guns and missile racks on its outer and inner decks.
colossus.name: COLOSSUS

grappler.note: 7-1: A salvage ship with grappling arms tipped with cannons.
grappler.name: GRAPPLER

tugmaster.note: 7-2: A space tug with two thrusters and a ram plate, radars and a reactor on deck.
tugmaster.name: TUGMASTER

magma_rig.note: 7-3: A mining rig with glowing furnaces and beam emitters.
magma_rig.name: MAGMA RIG

dreadnought.note: 7-4: A narrow battleship with deck turrets and a bow gun of twin cannons.
dreadnought.name: DREADNOUGHT

flare_rig.note: 7-5: An oil rig turned warship, flare stacks and turrets on its platform.
flare_rig.name: FLARE RIG

crucible.note: 7-6: A smelting block with furnaces on deck, beacons at the bow, missile racks and a reactor.
crucible.name: CRUCIBLE

executor.note: 8-1: A command ship with blade wings, gatlings and a turret.
executor.name: EXECUTOR

interdictor.note: 8-2: An interceptor carrier with sensor-dish wings and turrets all over.
interdictor.name: INTERDICTOR

nightwatch.note: 8-3: A dark gunboat with gatlings on deck and missile racks on its flanks.
nightwatch.name: NIGHTWATCH

arc_tower.note: 8-4: A floating power station with an arc emitter at the bow and flak nodes on deck.
arc_tower.name: ARC TOWER

apex.note: 8-5: A sleek flagship with heavy wing guns and two reactors at its stern.
apex.name: APEX

overmind.note: 8-6: A massive command ship whose shield generators armor its core, cannons, turrets and gatlings on its sides.
overmind.name: OVERMIND
